facts.text: Andrew mentioned that the newly adopted dog is still getting used to Toby and the new environment.

evidence.quote: He's doing great in his new home. Still getting used to Toby and the new environment.

facts.text: Andrew expressed that having pets brings a lot of happiness and companionship to their lives.

evidence.quote: I never imagined having pets would bring so much happiness. Pets really bring lots of joy and companionship to our lives.

facts.text: Andrew named the newly adopted dog Buddy because he considers him a buddy and hopes he and Toby will become buddies.

evidence.quote: I named him Buddy because he's my buddy and I hope him and Toby become buddies!
